research_boundary.oos_opening_condition: a trained-margin threshold must first pass every frozen pre-2024 materiality and economic selection gate
research_boundary.known_contamination: Historical PPOSM OOS windows were exposed by prior research. This experiment is research-only and cannot authorize deployment.

architecture.name: shadow_tp4_lifecycle_anchor_residual_router
architecture.reference_policy: ALWAYS_TP4 through the exact sequential scheduler
architecture.reference_anchor: a frozen active signal admitted by the always-TP4 shadow lifecycle
architecture.train_rows: two causal candidate rows, SKIP and TP12, for every pre-2024 reference anchor
architecture.inference: score only reference-anchor pairs; every non-anchor is deterministically TP4
architecture.shadow_causality: anchor membership is maintained from earlier shadow-TP4 entries and realized exits and is independent of learned scores

lifecycle_utility.counterfactual: replace exactly one reference anchor in the full always-TP4 route stream and replay the complete sequential portfolio
lifecycle_utility.delta_log_equity: log(candidate terminal equity) minus log(always-TP4 terminal equity), separately at 6bp and 10bp per side
lifecycle_utility.stress_mdd_delta: candidate strict-MDD fraction minus always-TP4 strict-MDD fraction
lifecycle_utility.violation: max(-base log-equity delta,0) + max(-stress log-equity delta,0) + max(stress MDD delta - 0.0001,0)
lifecycle_utility.switch_utility: risk-adjusted delta when base log-equity delta >= -epsilon, stress log-equity delta > epsilon, and stress MDD delta <= 0.0001 + epsilon; otherwise -(abs(risk-adjusted delta) + violation + epsilon)
lifecycle_utility.target: SWITCH iff switch utility > 0; ties KEEP

rlvr.utility_scale_source: exact median nonzero absolute lifecycle switch utility over the 204 pre-2024 rows

train_only_threshold_freeze.score: mean log probability over label tokens plus EOS; margin = SWITCH minus KEEP
train_only_threshold_freeze.grid: all distinct pre-2024 anchor margins plus nextafter sentinels
train_only_threshold_freeze.route: strict margin > threshold; dual switch chooses larger margin and exact ties prefer SKIP; non-anchors remain TP4
objective_order: maximize min(base CAGR/MDD delta, stress CAGR/MDD delta)
maximize min(base log-equity delta, stress log-equity delta)
train_only_threshold_freeze.no_feasible_threshold: record a train-stage failure and stop before generating or scoring OOS prompts

oos_protocol.prompt_rows: only always-TP4 shadow reference anchors; causal state, candidate, and anchor flag only; no target, utility, portfolio metric, or future outcome
oos_protocol.execution: exact next 5-minute open, TP/stop/48-hour cap, funding, non-overlap

stopping_rule: No OOS prompt generation or scoring unless the frozen model-margin threshold passes all pre-2024 selection gates; after OOS scoring, no architecture, threshold, decoding, or route repair.
